definitions.explanation: The correct order in which the strokes of a kanji or kana character should be written.

examples.japanese: {筆順|ひつじゅん}を{覚|おぼ}える。
この{漢字|かんじ}の{筆順|ひつじゅん}を{間違|まちが}えていた。
examples.english: I had been writing this kanji in the wrong stroke order.

examples.japanese: {小学校|しょうがっこう}では{漢字|かんじ}の{筆順|ひつじゅん}を{正|ただ}しく{教|おし}えることが{重視|じゅうし}されている。
examples.english: In elementary school, teaching the correct stroke order for kanji is considered important.

notes:
FORMATION: {筆|ひつ} (writing brush, writing) + {順|じゅん} (order, sequence).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {筆順|ひつじゅん}を{覚|おぼ}える: to learn stroke order
- {正|ただ}しい{筆順|ひつじゅん}: correct stroke order
- {筆順|ひつじゅん}を{間違|まちが}える: to get the stroke order wrong
- {筆順|ひつじゅん}{辞典|じてん}: stroke order dictionary

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {筆順|ひつじゅん}: stroke order (more common term)
- {書|か}き{順|じゅん}: stroke order (more colloquial synonym)
- {画数|かくすう}: stroke count (number of strokes, not their order)
